findings.title: Initial setup never persists the disabled archive command
findings.description: The new tick setup invokes `pg_settings.sh` while `archive_mode` is off. That library treats `archive_command=(disabled)` as restart-only and never adds it to the settings to persist. With no existing command, it also reports source-file DRIFT, which `step_apply` rejects before reaching the restart. Persist the command despite its disabled effective value, and test initial setup with archiving off.

findings.title: Production comparison rejects every post-install rerun
findings.description: Only the new cron lines have their added arguments stripped. After the first installation, `step_check` captures already-updated lines as `old`, so comparing an unchanged installed file against itself reports differences and stops step 4. This was reproduced with the helper. Normalize both sides and add an already-installed rerun test.

findings.title: Weekly recovery cannot resume after an upload failure
findings.description: If the base backup succeeds locally but its offsite upload fails, today's directory exists without an arm file. A retry invokes the full weekly command again, but `backup_prod.sh` rejects the existing destination before retrying its upload. Resume upload and reconciliation from the verified local backup rather than requiring its deletion or waiting another day.

findings.title: Filesystem failures bypass the promised failure report
findings.description: The handler catches only `StepFailed` and `CalledProcessError`. Operations inside steps can raise `OSError`—for example, reading a missing production health log or creating the arm file. Those failures escape `run_steps`, so `main` never writes the report despite potentially completed host changes. Handle these failures at the orchestration boundary and guarantee report generation.
